title: What is missing?
prompt: Someone gives only a[n+1] = 2a[n]. What additional information selects one sequence in this setting?
hint: Compare the sequences beginning at 1 and at 3.

options.text: A starting value, such as a[0] = 1.
A sufficiently large number of likes.

feedback.pass: With an initial value and this single-valued update, each later value is determined. Not every general recurrence guarantees uniqueness.
feedback.fail: For this recurrence, the starting value is the missing information.
